claim: In the matching retail DLL, two uAudio.uAudioPlayer getters have the same exact 29-byte backend-or-fallback control-flow shape. get_AudioTitle (0x060052D5), raw MethodDef row 585732000000e609538a0700b2490000553d, RVA 0x00325758, signature 20000e, code SHA-256 c90322aba94a9bdb71409ad82330912a9b3749566383217b56951c45c2a42293: if this._uAudio (0x040087E3) is non-null it calls backend uAudio.get_AudioTitle through memberref 0x0A000FB7 and returns the String; otherwise it loads static System.String.Empty through memberref 0x0A000025 and returns it. get_TotalTime (0x060052DA), row fc5732000000e6099e8a07006e480100573d, RVA 0x003257FC, signature 20001182c1, code SHA-256 c2d0be581347b6907ae28115746372eaad0f60669f9234113bc3e38abfbd3994: if _uAudio is non-null it calls backend uAudio.get_TotalTime through memberref 0x0A000FBC and returns the System.TimeSpan; otherwise it loads static System.TimeSpan.Zero through memberref 0x0A000FBD and returns it. No inbound direct in-assembly MethodDef caller edge is promoted for either getter.
